title: Few-Shot Fairness: Unveiling LLM’s Potential for Fairness-Aware Classification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness metrics (such as Demographic Parity, Equal Opportunity, Equalized Odds, and Disparate Impact) on binary income classification predictions using the UCI Adult Income dataset, specifically comparing classification outcomes between male and female demographic groups under zero-shot and few-shot in-context learning setups.
